title: Special use allowances around easement volumes
previewText:
In all Residence Districts, uses listed under Use Group VI shall be permitted within a distance of 30 feet from the outermost edge of the easement volume:

at the ground floor level of a building on a zoning lots with an easement volume serving an at- or below-grade mass transit station, or at the two lowest stories of a building on a zoning lot with an easement volume serving an above-grade mass transit station.
